boundary_rationale: Onset: 3:24 has the king astonished and questioning his counselors; behind the edge, a PE (single-witness) follows 3:23. The opener then is weak, so the onset leans on the PE and the change of focus. Close: 3:27 has the assembled officials see that `web:Dan.3.27` “the fire had no power on their bodies”, a witness report that seals the rescue. Across the edge, 3:28 moves from narration to royal speech with the blessing formula (blessed_aram); its answered-and-said opener is weak by itself. Inside the span a SAMEKH (single-witness) follows 3:25, between the sight of four men and the call to come out; it is weighed as a rival and not taken.

boundary_rationale: Onset: 3:30 is the narrator's notice after the king's speech closes at 3:29; its opener then (then_aram) is weak, and the change from quoted speech to narration carries the onset. Close: a PE (single-witness) follows 3:30, and the parent seam falls here. Across the edge, `web:Dan.4.1`=`oshb:Dan.3.31` opens the encyclical prescript addressed to the peoples. The promotion notice rounds off the account and echoes the provincial appointment at 2:49 (context verse, read and not tiled).
